mentions.h: BELS. 13th IN NATIONAL RELAY WORST PERFORMANCE SINCE 1927
BELS. 5th in NATIONAL RELAY — Mixed form on Brighton Road
Bronze in National Relay DERBY SNATCH SILVER

photos.c: CENTRE: The leaders at 2½ miles. Batty, Briault and Johnston lead from Craig, Strong, Turner and Fowler with Don Taylor and Montague partly hidden. Heatley (the winner) and Bullivant complete the leading group. Gerry North, Simpson and Kilby lead the following bunch.

TOP LEFT: Bill Kerr trails Bullivant and Tulloh on Stage 9. TOP RIGHT: John Thresher hands over to a determined Trevor Hart after stage 2. CENTRE: Alan Mead and 'Noddy' Edwards, with some female assistance, cheer on the runners! BOTTOM LEFT: Laurie O'Hara hands over to Gerry North after chopping 17 secs off the Club record for stage 7. BOTTOM RIGHT: Alan Black brings Belgrave home in 4th place.
